title: Fix notification tap navigating to Google search instead of user profile

requirements.summary: Fix the notification item tap/click handler in the Notifications page so that tapping a notification navigates to the referenced user's in-app profile page instead of triggering a Google search for the username.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping a notification item navigates to the referenced user's profile page within the app.
No external browser navigation or Google search is triggered when tapping a notification.
The correct username/principal is passed to the profile route so the right profile loads.
Navigation works for all notification types that reference a user.

file_operations.description: Replace the current notification item click handler that constructs an external href (triggering Google search) with a TanStack Router navigate call to the in-app profile route. Use the existing `useNavigate` hook from '@tanstack/react-router' (already imported in App.tsx and other components). When a notification is clicked, call `navigate({ to: '/profile/$userId', params: { userId: notification.senderId.toString() } })` to route to the sender's profile page within the app. Ensure the notification senderId Principal is converted to a string for the route param. Remove any anchor tag or href that constructs a search URL, and replace it with an onClick handler or use the router's Link component with proper params.
